User able to push to the repo could make delete-time hooks create resources in namespaces or kinds the AppProject forbids; effect arises when the Application is deleted.
A board member could modify comment blocks created by other users via the block patch endpoints without the others-comments permission.
Tenant could bind another tenant's GitHub App installation_id to its own workspace via connect/complete and read that tenant's repositories.
